claim: As beta tends to infinity, the DPO loss divided by beta converges to hinge loss max(0, delta_ref-delta), whose threshold delta_ref can be negative.
quantifiers: Every fixed finite pair (delta, delta_ref) in R^2 as beta tends to positive infinity.
verification_rule: VERIFIED if the uniform error bound 0 <= softplus(beta*a)/beta-max(0,a) <= log(2)/beta is checked with boundary and sign controls.
limitations: This is an asymptotic objective identity; it does not establish downstream model behavior at a particular finite beta.
